description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Awoken Earth], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast] and [Monolith Sword] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Awoken Earth
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Monolith Sword
description.text: Grants [Earth Ability +30% Boost 1] to all allies after using two Earth abilities
